selection: Maximum best medium-validation mIoU over 10 epochs per dataset; ties retain candidate order. All candidates reported. No test evaluation.
precision: FP32 with TF32 disabled for CUDA operator compatibility; independent-backbone recipe, not precision-matched ablation
optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay=0.0001, gradient norm clipping=1; cosine lr to 0.05*initial
inputs: 8192 records; existing normalized local XYZ/scalar base features; metric local XYZ for ball queries; no RGB, pretrained model or additional augmentations
validation: Existing split and seed42; all dataset classes, fixed sampled evaluation
post_training_review: Review validation trajectories and class counts before test; no claim of convergence from a 10-epoch pilot. Any extension is separately documented before test.
